# IBERFIT WEB V6.43.2 · app visual sources

These four WebP files are derived from authenticated **IBERFIT QA / Canary** visual evidence generated by the Device Experience Gate on 2026-09-19.

Source app repository: `iberfit/iberfit-m26-app`

- App Canary SHA: `f99975c3c2295b4ebc44fa94ea68d683cb3956fc`
- Device Experience Gate run: `35463692246`
- Source artifact: `device-gate-workflow-matrix-35463692246`
- Artifact id: `10590278427`
- Supabase environment represented by the gate: QA (`gjztkdwfmunnzhtvxrsu`)

## Published crops

- `app-online-plan.webp` — current client "Hoy" / planning surface.
- `app-online-session.webp` — current client live-session surface.
- `app-online-progress.webp` — current client progress surface.
- `app-hybrid-feedback.webp` — current client session-close / feedback surface.

The crops intentionally exclude the QA profile/sidebar identifiers and use synthetic demonstration data only. They are marketing evidence of the real product surface, not a representation of any real client account.

The build copies these sources into `candidate/v628/assets/` only after V6.43.2 release QA starts. Production-facing copies are therefore tied to the certified web candidate rather than loaded from GitHub Actions artifacts at runtime.
